title: Packaging and Filling Machine Operators and Tenders
description: Operate or tend machines to prepare industrial or consumer products for storage or shipment. Includes cannery workers who pack food products.

projection.title: Packaging and filling machine operators and tenders

tasks.text: Attach identification labels to finished packaged items, or cut stencils and stencil information on containers, such as lot numbers or shipping destinations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking workpieces is hands-on physical task

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.

tasks.text: Sort, grade, weigh, and inspect products, verifying and adjusting product weight or measurement to meet specifications.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Weigh finished products.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Sort materials or products for processing, storing, shipping, or grading.

tasks.text: Stop or reset machines when malfunctions occur, clear machine jams, and report malfunctions to a supervisor.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Notifying maintenance needs is routine messaging

dwas.name: Clear equipment jams.
Notify others of equipment repair or maintenance needs.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Observe machine operations to ensure quality and conformity of filled or packaged products to standards.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical product flaw monitoring is on-machine

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure that products are not flawed.

tasks.text: Remove finished packaged items from machine and separate rejected items.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Monitor the production line, watching for problems such as pile-ups, jams, or glue that isn't sticking properly.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Malfunction detection relies on live physical observation

dwas.name: Watch operating equipment to detect malfunctions.

tasks.text: Inspect and remove defective products and packaging material.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Start machine by engaging controls.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically packaging products for shipment

dwas.name: Package products for storage or shipment.

tasks.text: Tend or operate machine that packages product.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically packaging products for shipment

dwas.name: Package products for storage or shipment.

tasks.text: Clean, oil, and make minor adjustments or repairs to machinery and equipment, such as opening valves or setting guides.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on repair of production machinery

dwas.name: Clean production equipment.
Repair production equipment or tools.
Lubricate production equipment.

tasks.text: Regulate machine flow, speed, or temperature.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual temperature control adjustment

dwas.name: Adjust temperature controls of ovens or other heating equipment.

tasks.text: Adjust machine components and machine tension and pressure according to size or processing angle of product.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically packaging products for shipment

dwas.name: Package products for storage or shipment.

tasks.text: Supply materials to spindles, conveyors, hoppers, or other feeding devices and unload packaged product.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Feeding materials into equipment is physical

dwas.name: Feed materials or products into or through equipment.

tasks.text: Stack finished packaged items, or wrap protective material around each item, and pack the items in cartons or containers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically packaging products for shipment

dwas.name: Stack finished items for further processing or shipment.
Package products for storage or shipment.

tasks.text: Package the product in the form in which it will be sent out, for example, filling bags with flour from a chute or spout.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically packaging products for shipment

dwas.name: Package products for storage or shipment.

tasks.text: Stock and sort product for packaging or filling machine operation, and replenish packaging supplies, such as wrapping paper, plastic sheet, boxes, cartons, glue, ink, or labels.

tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual cleaning of materials for production
